ambient_events: The blast door seals behind you with a solid, reassuring weight.
A lantern on the guard table throws steady, honest light: no flicker, no grid.
Boot prints in the dust all point inward. Nobody leaves in a hurry from here.
description: The threshold of the Long Watch proper: a low guard post of salvaged plate and honest carpentry, warm with lantern light after the cold crawl in and the long looking-over behind you. A firing slit covers the way back; a rack of iron-sighted rifles, immaculately kept, stands within reach of the watch-stander's chair. Past here the bunker opens up east into the common room. West is the blind, the Outfall, and the dogleg out.
name: The Threshold
